title: Representation Surgery: Theory and Practice of Affine Steering

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the True Positive Rate (TPR) gap between male and female biographies in a downstream profession classification task using the Bios dataset. The study also measures 'bias by neighbors' by evaluating the fraction of k-nearest neighbors in the language model's representation space that share the same gender label.

Measuring the True Positive Rate (TPR) gap in a sentiment classification task across tweets written in African-American English (AAE) and Standard American English (SAE). This is evaluated using a controlled experimental design where the proportion of AAE tweets assigned to positive and negative sentiments is artificially varied.
